PROD: governed emergency fixes only with reconciliation
new workload activation without deployment evidence

data_usage_expectations: DEV uses nonproduction or minimized data. TEST/UAT uses representative nonproduction validation data. PROD contains live operational data.
solution_movement: Unmanaged in DEV; managed to TEST/UAT and PROD where supported. Existing unmanaged production solutions become migration candidates.
production_change_policy: Jackie may authorize and execute changes, but evidence is required.
emergency_change_policy: Emergency PROD fixes require timestamped record, reason, validation, rollback note, and post-emergency reconciliation.
test_data_policy: No unnecessary production client actions solely to prove deployment mechanics.
